points.description: States the answer is FALSE (the OS does not simply continue with the next instruction).
points.partial_credit: Half if the reasoning is right but FALSE is not stated clearly.

points.description: Explains that the faulting instruction is re-executed after the handler creates the mapping (the PC is not incremented / not moved to the next instruction).
points.partial_credit: Half if it only says the mapping fix is not the whole story or that the instruction is retried, with little detail.

rubric.notes: Full marks: says FALSE and says the faulting instruction is re-run, not the next one, in any wording. Give part marks for FALSE with a vague or missing reason, or for the right re-execution idea with no clear verdict. Give 0 for TRUE or unrelated answers. Extra remarks don't cost marks unless they contradict this idea.
